name: Magnet-TS-TW
blurb: Wraps children that lean toward the cursor within a radius, easing back to rest.
description: DOM-based interactive wrapper that translates its child toward the pointer within a configurable padding radius, with separate easing curves for active and inactive states.
use_when: A single hero CTA or card that should feel tactile without shifting its neighbors' layout.
avoid_when: Dense toolbars or touch-only surfaces — there is no pointer to track and hover detection is unreliable.
a11y: Wrapper only; focus and keyboard behaviour come from the child. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
